The system still placed 2 out of 3 executed orders as SELL setups despite the regime being clearly bullish, directly contradicting yesterday's learnings about rejecting counter-trend trades.
regime_impact: The strong trending_up regime (ADX 25, Nifty +1.9%, VIX 12.2) crushed all SELL setups. Only BUY setups aligned with the trend had any chance. The system failed to enforce regime-based filtering despite explicit notes recommending it.

improvements.reason: ONGC SELL (28% prob) and COALINDIA SELL (32% prob) were placed in a +1.9% trending_up day. Both were obvious losers. This same mistake has repeated for weeks.

improvements.action: Set hard minimum AI probability threshold at 60% for ANY order placement. Do not place orders below this regardless of other factors.
improvements.reason: ONGC at 28% and COALINDIA at 32% should never have been placed. HDFCBANK at 25% was correctly skipped but only because it wasn't triggered — it should have been filtered out entirely.

improvements.action: For BUY setups in trending_up regime, set entry price at or slightly above current price (chase entries) rather than waiting for pullback to demand zone when ADX > 22 and day gain > 1%.
improvements.reason: INFY BUY at ₹1,157.20 never triggered likely because the strong uptrend didn't pull back to the demand zone. In strong trends, waiting for perfect entries means missing trades entirely.

improvements.reason: The system found only 1 valid setup (INFY) but still placed 3 orders by including counter-trend SELLs. Better to have 0 trades than forced losers.
